categories.name: mining
categories.evidence: Carries the Mining label and modifies getblocktemplate caching in src/rpc/mining.cpp and src/node/block_template_manager.cpp.
categories.rationale: Encapsulates template caching logic into BlockTemplateManager to eliminate process-scoped global statics. This fixes a test-environment lifetime issue where cached raw CBlockIndex pointers could outlive the ChainstateManager across node contexts, adds unit test coverage, and unblocks further global state removal under #33758.

categories.name: rpc
categories.evidence: Changes internal mining template cache lifetime rather than the RPC interface, transport, or argument handling.
categories.rationale: The change touches src/rpc/mining.cpp only to delegate template caching to node-scoped mining architecture; RPC behavior itself is strictly area-specific to mining.
